notes.title: Version Update 1.1
notes.content:
Update content
・Game story
   Update the final chapter of the game story.
   The new chapter is about the "excrement" job that Seiko did not challenge in the previous story.
   The chapter includes some gross images might make player fell uncomfotble， so we make the new chapter unlock level a bit higher.
   →Final chapter unlock level 35
   →Achieve the required score of 800,000

・ Update  High score  system
  Record the highest score the player receives in「 Record」 mode
  High score can be viewed in the main game interface.

・ Fix typo in a game tutorial
-------------------------------------------------- -
~ Official high score play tips ~
The way to getting the high score is all about the number of combos，
the more combo you have the higher score you will get.
